Cross-provider session-verification R1 routed to gpt-5-4. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND. Three findings: Minor DDL fallback rows in field-type table (TypeCode 9/10/17/18) omitted unsized spellings; Minor dbVariableField hex value wrong (0x00000001 documented; correct is 0x00000002, 0x00000001 is dbFixedField); Major closeout artifacts (change-log.md + disposition.json) contained 'awaiting fill' / 'fill at close' / 'pending fill' placeholders incompatible with the declared complete status.

Applied R1 fixes in-session: per-field-type table rows for TypeCode 9/10/17/18 now show both sized and unsized DDL spellings to match TableDdlBuilder.MapType; Multi-valued fields paragraph corrected to dbVariableField 0x00000002 and dbFixedField 0x00000001; closeout placeholders replaced with concrete R1 verdict + cost prose in change-log.md and disposition.json.

Cross-provider session-verification R2 routed to gpt-5-4. Verdict: VERIFIED with empty issues array. R2 confirmed all three R1 fixes hold and no new issues were introduced; post-fix narrative-summary sweep clean.
Staged + committed + pushed the closeout commit (14 files; 1173 insertions; commit 4f6aa6e). Spurious .accdb timestamp diffs from the test run were reverted before staging per the documented sweep.
